steps.content: Joan is surrounded by theater staff, looking very impatient.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: This script is terrible... "I am a talented musician. My friends are jealous of my talent and are trying to suppress me in the market?"

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: This is against the spirit of rock and roll, what kind of performance is this?
With the theater staff's earnest reassurances, Joan reluctantly stays on the stage.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Fine, fine...! I'll play along. Where were we with the script... "Heartbroken and devastated by a friend's slander, I was crushed"...

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Okay, I'll lie down on the bed over there for a bit. That's sad enough, right?
Joan lies on the bed for a while, her hand itching to reach for the guitar in the corner. A visitor knocks on the door.

steps.speaker: Musician
steps.content: It's me... My friend... You don't need to open the door for me, I don't deserve to stand before you... just listen to my confession...

steps.speaker: Musician
steps.content: I was surely bewitched by the devil for the wrongs I've done to you... No, don't blame the devil... It's me... It's my soul that was consumed by jealousy.

steps.speaker: Musician
steps.content: But you, my friend... You have the purest soul in the world, you have the talent I admire most in this world... If you can ever forgive me...

steps.speaker: Musician
steps.content: I will spend the rest of my life to support your art. I want to play music with you until my bitter end.
The door is yanked open.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Get your sheets.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: What are you waiting for? I thought you said you're playing music with me til' your bitter end?

Music plays, and the two sing a duet. Guilt over the past, joy of reunion, admiration for each other's talents... All blended into one song, the musician's mood gradually relaxes, until... Joan breaks a string from strumming too hard.
The musician looks at Joan in slight fear, but Joan just starts laughing.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Okay, all these crap from the past, just let them go like this broken string.
She looks around the stage, and walks up to you and stuffs the old string into your hand.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Keep this for me.
She quickly replaces it with a new string from her guitar case.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: New string, new start...

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Rock on!
